French restaurant in the heart of Asia
Nov 2025 • Solo
Looking for lunch and a little tired of the Asian flavor, I was looking in the most European city for the most European restaurant. And the tropics I eat twice a day, and the gastronomic pleasure of every meal is greatly appreciated. I take a long time to pick places.
On google maps and tripadvisor found this place with a rating of 4.7 and didn't miss.

A very beautiful colonial-style house, inside every element of the interior tastefully, such a combination of French Provence with Asian nature (flowers, ficus, lianas, palm trees).

The local "colonial" cuisine combines the traditions of Europe with scones, soups, pasta, meat in all kinds of sauces, seafood with the local: sauces, fruit, rice. This produced black spaghetti with octopus and a warm salad with potatoes, nuts and artichokes. 
I don't really like stewed vegetables, but artichokes are a local attraction, they make BADAS, tea, tinctures and all sorts of dishes. Even in the central square of Dalat there is a big artichoke! How do you not try a local thing?
By the way, it turned out very delicious, and fueled with good French wine🥂
As a compliment, at the beginning, all good restaurants bring bread, baguettes, mini pizzas - also following European traditions.
By the way, small flower pots they make out of eggshells - in recent photos🥚

By the way, the prices here are quite reasonable for this quality, a lunch of 2 courses and 2 glasses of wine cost about 2000 rubles (and this is an expensive restaurant by Vietnamese standards), and in hotels on the coast of Cam Rani the prices are even higher, although the quality often suffers.
